rows.candidate_spl: search index=<auth_index> sourcetype=<auth_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now | eval user_norm=lower(coalesce(user, username, src_user, Account_Name, TargetUserName, "unknown")), src_ip_norm=coalesce(src_ip, src, source, source_ip, Source_Network_Address, "unknown") | sort 0 + _time | streamstats time_window=10m dc(user_norm) as distinct_count by src_ip_norm | where distinct_count > 1 | stats max(distinct_count) as distinct_count by src_ip_norm

search index=<auth_index> sourcetype=<auth_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now (action=success OR EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=4723 OR EventCode=4724 OR action=password_change) | eval event_type=case(EventCode=4723 OR EventCode=4724 OR action=password_change, "password_change", action=success OR EventCode=4624, "successful_login") | fields _time, user, event_type | sort 0 + _time | streamstats window=1 current=f last(event_type) as prev_event last(_time) as prev_time by user | where prev_event="password_change" AND event_type="successful_login" AND (_time-prev_time)<=300 | stats count as sequence_matches earliest(_time) as first_match_epoch latest(_time) as last_match_epoch by user | eval first_match=strftime(first_match_epoch, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last_match=strftime(last_match_epoch, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | fields - first_match_epoch last_match_epoch

search index=<auth_index> sourcetype=<auth_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now (action=success OR action=failure) | where (date_hour<7) OR (date_hour>=19) | stats count as after_hours_logins dc(host) as distinct_hosts values(host) as hosts values(src) as source_ips min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by user | sort -after_hours_logins | head 100
search index=<auth_index> sourcetype=<auth_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now signature=account_locked | timechart span=1h count as lockout_count | head 100

search index=<auth_index> sourcetype=<auth_sourcetype> earliest=-60m latest=now action=failure | stats count as failed_logins dc(user) as distinct_users min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(action) as action by host, src | where failed_logins >= 25 | sort -failed_logins | head 100

search index=<auth_index> sourcetype=<auth_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now action=failure NOT (user="svc_*" OR user="service_*" OR user="*_svc") | stats count as fail_count values(src) as source_ips min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by user | sort -fail_count | head 100

search index=<auth_index> sourcetype=<auth_sourcetype> earliest=-60m latest=now (action=failure OR action=success) | stats count(eval(action="failure")) as fail_count count(eval(action="success")) as success_count values(src) as source_ips values(host) as hosts min(eval(if(action="failure", _time, null()))) as first_failure max(eval(if(action="success", _time, null()))) as last_success max(_time) as last_event by user | where fail_count >= 5 AND success_count >= 1 | eval risk="P2 review - successful login after repeated failures" | table user hosts source_ips fail_count success_count first_failure last_success last_event risk | sort -fail_count | head 100

search index=<aws_index> sourcetype=<aws_cloudtrail_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now eventSource=iam.amazonaws.com (eventName=CreatePolicy OR eventName=CreatePolicyVersion OR eventName=SetDefaultPolicyVersion OR eventName=DeletePolicy OR eventName=DeletePolicyVersion OR eventName=PutUserPolicy OR eventName=PutRolePolicy OR eventName=PutGroupPolicy OR eventName=DeleteUserPolicy OR eventName=DeleteRolePolicy OR eventName=DeleteGroupPolicy OR eventName=AttachUserPolicy OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=AttachGroupPolicy OR eventName=DetachUserPolicy OR eventName=DetachRolePolicy OR eventName=DetachGroupPolicy) | stats count as change_count values(eventName) as event_names values(requestParameters.policyArn) as policy_arns values(requestParameters.userName) as target_users values(requestParameters.roleName) as target_roles values(sourceIPAddress) as source_ips min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by userIdentity.arn userIdentity.userName awsRegion | sort -change_count | head 100

search index=<cisco_firewall_index> sourcetype=<cisco_firewall_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now (dest_port=80 OR dest_port=5900 OR app=HTTP OR app=VNC) | where dest_ip IN ([ search index=<network_index> sourcetype=<network_traffic_sourcetype> earliest=-7d latest=now tag=phase1_rtu | stats count by ip | fields ip | rename ip as dest_ip | head 100 ]) | stats count as session_count values(app) as applications values(dest_port) as dest_ports min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by src_ip dest_ip | sort -session_count | head 100

search index=<stealthwatch_index> sourcetype=<stealthwatch_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now (alert_type=horizontal_scan OR threat_category=scan) | lookup ot_asset_inventory.csv ip as src_ip OUTPUT asset_name asset_type criticality | where isnotnull(asset_name) | stats count as scan_events values(asset_name) as assets values(asset_type) as asset_types values(criticality) as criticality min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by src_ip | sort -scan_events | head 100

search index=<dns_index> sourcetype=<dns_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now | stats count as DNS_query_count values(query) as domain values(dest) as dest values(bytes_out) as bytes_out dc(query) as distinct_domains min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by src | eval observation_window=last_seen-first_seen | eval periodicity=if(DNS_query_count>1,round(observation_window/(DNS_query_count-1),2),null()) | eval jitter="requires_review" | eval rare_domain_indicator=if(distinct_domains<=3 AND DNS_query_count>=20,"review","unknown") | eval user_host_association=src | where DNS_query_count >= 20 | table src dest domain DNS_query_count periodicity jitter bytes_out rare_domain_indicator user_host_association first_seen last_seen | sort -DNS_query_count | head 100

search index=<endpoint_index> sourcetype=<endpoint_process_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now (process_name=powershell.exe OR process_name=pwsh.exe OR command_line="*powershell*" OR script_block_text="*") | eval encoded_command_flag=if(match(command_line,"(?i)(-enc|-encodedcommand)"),"true","false") | stats count as event_count values(command_line) as command_line values(script_block_text) as script_block_text values(parent_process) as parent_process values(process_name) as process_name values(event_id) as event_id values(encoded_command_flag) as encoded_command_flag values(dest) as network_connection min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by host,user | sort -event_count | head 100

search index=<endpoint_index> sourcetype=<endpoint_process_sourcetype> earliest=-6h latest=now | eval rule_name=coalesce(rule_name,process_name,"edr_detection") | eval mitre_technique=coalesce(mitre_technique_id,"T1059.001") | eval mitre_tactic=coalesce(mitre_tactic,"Execution") | eval urgency=case(match(severity,"(?i)critical"),"critical",match(severity,"(?i)high"),"high",true(),"medium") | stats count as alert_count values(rule_name) as rule_name values(mitre_technique) as mitre_technique values(mitre_tactic) as mitre_tactic values(urgency) as urgency values(severity) as severity min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by host | where urgency IN ("critical","high") | sort -alert_count | head 100

search index=<network_index> sourcetype=<network_traffic_sourcetype> earliest=-24h latest=now | stats latest(banner) as observed_banner latest(firmware) as observed_firmware by ip | lookup ot_asset_inventory.csv ip OUTPUT expected_firmware asset_name asset_type | where isnotnull(expected_firmware) AND observed_firmware!=expected_firmware | table ip asset_name asset_type observed_firmware expected_firmware | sort ip | head 100
